ModMetaData.name: Image Opt + Faster Game Loading Compatibility Patch
ModMetaData.author: DegradingAnt
ModMetaData.description:
Compatibility patch for running IMAGE OPT together with FASTER GAME LOADING - CONTINUED (PREVIEW). It needs BOTH of those mods installed. It does not replace or modify either one; it patches around them.
Developed on a 1,478-mod list (the Progression pack), where this combination otherwise black-screened at load.
REQUIRES - Image Opt (soeur) - Faster Game Loading - Continued (Preview). Use the Preview, not the regular build: the Preview carries the Image Opt compatibility layer this patch depends on. Both builds share a package id, so the mod list cannot enforce this - the patch checks at startup and warns if the wrong one is active.
TESTED VERSIONS - Image Opt 0.1.13 - Faster Game Loading - Continued (Preview) 2026.09.07.1, all settings at their defaults - Harmony 2.4.2 / RimWorld 1.6.4871 Other versions may work. The patch warns if it sees one it was not tested with, because this patch reaches into both mods' internals and a renamed field would quietly switch parts of it off.
FIXES FOR IMAGE OPT + FASTER GAME LOADING - Pixel-readback fix, for any mod - Image Opt's textures live on the GPU, so any mod reading texture pixels gets an error or blank data. The patch answers those reads from a CPU-readable copy. It covers every mod automatically rather than a fixed list. - Orphaned .dds.zstd sweep - removes Image Opt cache files whose source image has gone, which would otherwise show as stale textures. Never touches plain .dds. - Faster Game Loading checks - warns at startup if the regular build is active instead of the Preview, or if its settings differ from the tested defaults.
ALSO PATCHES THESE OTHER MODS Each is only touched if it is installed. If it is not, that part does nothing. - Vehicle Framework (SmashPhil), plus Vanilla Vehicles Expanded, Vehicle Map Framework and other vehicle packs - vehicle liveries are built by reading texture pixels, which Image Opt breaks. The pixel-readback fix repairs them. - Vanilla Expanded Framework (Oskar Potocki) - its dev-tool opener reads a keybinding before the game's data is ready, which throws an error every frame on the loading screen. It is held back until that data exists. - Worldbuilder - reads its own settings before they have loaded, with the same result. It is held back until they exist.
KNOWN GAPS - please read - The vehicle livery has not been visually confirmed yet. - A mod calling the five-argument GetPixels overload directly is not covered - that one method is native and cannot be patched. The standard overloads are. - Most fixes touch Unity types the test suite cannot load, so they are verified by inspection, not by tests.
Written with AI assistance and reviewed by a second, independent AI reviewer. Source and known issues on GitHub. MIT licensed, fixes welcome.
The preview image is adapted from Image Opt's logo. If soeur or any other author whose work this touches would like anything changed or removed, ask and it will be done promptly.
